title: Mode
description: A job playbook: one logical job. Its features each run steps: code steps (run: <capability>/v<N>.<endpoint>), agentic steps (role: <role>) and gates. Modes name capabilities, never concrete tools.

extends.description: Parent mode, resolved at build time: the child inherits features, playbooks, rules, review settings, roles (the role -> env map, overridden entry by entry), coordinator, constraints, configDefaults, needs, config, types, skills and the coordinator playbook, and overrides any of them (a child's feature replaces the parent's feature of that name whole, never key by key). Inheritance cycles and missing parents are errors.

abstract.description: A base for `extends` only: linted, never resolved, installed or called. Not inherited.

features.description: What the mode can do, one entry per feature, called as <mode>.<feature>: its interface (in, out, effects), its steps, and optionally a playbook and rules. A feature with no role step (code only) needs neither file.

steps.description: The feature's steps, in order. A review step is injected from `review` (at a `{review: here}` marker, else after the last step).

effects.description: Everything this feature may do. Every step's effects must be declared here and allowed by the env.

playbook.description: features/<feature>/playbook.md (relative to the mode folder). Required when a step runs a role; a code-only feature has none.

uses.description: The read endpoints (<interface>/v<N>.<endpoint>, e.g. items.store/v1.sql) this feature's role steps may call through the use shim. Each must be granted to a role of the feature; `[]` means none. Required when a role of the feature is granted any.

skills.description: The mode's skills (short names) the step plan hands this feature's role steps. Absent: every skill of the mode.

tier.description: Tier of the review step (default: the review role's tier).

rulesets.description: Framework rule sets (framework/rules/<name>.yaml, e.g. conformance) added to the reviewer's plan next to the feature's DoD and rules.

review.description: Optional. The ONLY place review is configured. when: always injects a review step after the output step.

roles.description: This feature's role -> env overrides over the mode's `roles` (e.g. forge.extend: {builder: framework-dev}). Only roles the mode lists.

tier.description: Tier of this feature's role steps (default: each role's tier). A step's own `tier` wins; review steps take theirs from `review`.

effort.description: Effort of this feature's role steps (default: each role's effort). A step's own `effort` wins.

roles.description: The roles this mode uses and the env each one works in: {role: env}. Features and steps may override entries (`roles:` of the same shape); one env per step. Children inherit the map and override it entry by entry.

monthlyItems.description: Items a source may read per UTC month.

needs.description: Interfaces the mode's steps and roles use, versioned (`<interface>/v<N>`); `bay check` refuses an unversioned name (B-6).

reads.description: Item kinds (content types) the mode reads, versioned (`<kind>/v<N>`, e.g. `<kind>/v1`). `bay check` refuses an unversioned or unknown kind, and a kind or version that no items.source connector bound in the mode's envs produces (B-6). An abstract mode may declare none; inherited by children unless they set their own.

config.description: JSON Schema file (in the mode folder) for agentbay.config.yaml modes.<name>.

configDefaults.description: Defaults that replace the config schema's `default`s for this mode (e.g. a child's own default selectors), so a child never copies its parent's config schema. Merged key by key over the parent's; each key must be a property of the config schema and its value must match it.

run.description: Code step: <capability>/v<N>.<endpoint>, e.g. items.store/v1.sync (same spelling as role `uses`).

with.description: Input for a code step. "$in.<field>" and "$steps.<id>.<field>" are substituted; missing values are dropped.

when.description: `stale > 2h` (code step: skip unless the store is older), `$in.<field>` or `$steps.<id>.<field>` (skip unless truthy); a leading `!` skips when true instead.

task.description: What the role should do in this step (goal of its TaskEnvelope).

gate.description: Approval gate: the dispatcher stops with status awaiting-approval and shows this text; only the owner passes it, with `bay approve <callId>` (a terminal, or `--via chat` when approvals.chat is on). A gate takes no `when:`.

approves.description: Gate only: `$in.<field>` names a project file whose exact content the gate approves; `|$steps.<id>.<field>` falls back to the docs/proposals file listed in an earlier step's output (its `artifacts`). The ledger records its path and sha256 with the approval; a later call naming the same file with the same content skips the gate, any edit makes it run again.

review.description: Position marker for the review step configured on the feature (mode.yaml features.<f>.review). Without a marker, review runs after the last step.

roles.description: This step's env for its role ({<role>: <env>}, one entry), over the feature's and the mode's.

tier.description: Tier of this role step (over the feature's and the role's).

effort.description: Effort of this role step (over the feature's and the role's).

tier.description: fast | balanced | deep; the agent profile maps it to a model.
